title: Integrated analysis of single-cell and bulk transcriptomics reveals cellular subtypes and molecular features associated with osteosarcoma prognosis.
authors: Liu, Feng; Zhang, Tingting; Yang, Yongqiang; Wang, Kailun; Wei, Jinlan; Shi, Ji-Hua; Zhang, Dong; Sheng, Xia; Zhang, Yi; Zhou, Jing; Zhao, Faming
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单细胞与bulk转录组分析骨肉瘤细胞亚型与预后，虽涉及转录因子ATF6alpha，但核心是表达谱与肿瘤纯度预测，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteosarcoma (OS) is the most common primary bone malignancy with variable molecular biology and prognosis. However, our understanding of the association between cell types and OS progression remains poor. METHODS: We generated a human OS cell atlas by integrating over 110,000 single cells from 17 samples. Multiple machine learning algorithms were applied to develop tumor purity prediction models based on transcriptomic profile of OS. The Scissor algorithm and gene enrichment analyses were conducted to delve into cell-intrinsic molecular characteristics linked to OS prognosis. Moreover, the study investigated the impact of ATF6alpha in OS aggressiveness through genetic and pharmacological loss of function analyses. Lastly, the CellChat algorithm was employed to investigate cell-cell communications. RESULTS: Utilizing the high-quality human OS cell atlas, we identified tumor purity as a prognostic indicator and developed a robust tumor purity prediction model. We respectively delineated cancer cell- and immune cell-intrinsic molecular characteristics associated with OS prognosis at single-cell resolution. Interestingly, tumor cells with activated unfolded protein response (UPR) pathway were significantly associated with disease aggressiveness. Notably, ATF6alpha emerged as the top-activated transcription factor for this tumor subcluster. Subsequently, we confirmed that ATF6alpha was markedly associated with OS progression, while both genetic and pharmacological inhibition of ATF6alpha impaired the survival of HOS cells. Lastly, we depicted the landscape of signal crosstalk between the UPR-related subcluster and other cell types within the tumor microenvironment. CONCLUSION: In summary, our work provides novel insights into the molecular biology of OS, and offers valuable resource for OS biomarker discovery and treatment strategy development.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）是最常见的原发性骨恶性肿瘤，其分子生物学特征和预后具有变异性。然而，我们对细胞类型与骨肉瘤进展之间关联的理解仍十分有限。方法：我们通过整合来自17个样本的超过110,000个单细胞，构建了人类骨肉瘤细胞图谱。应用多种机器学习算法，基于骨肉瘤的转录组谱开发了肿瘤纯度预测模型。采用Scissor算法和基因富集分析，深入探讨与骨肉瘤预后相关的细胞内在分子特征。此外，本研究通过遗传和药理学功能缺失分析，探讨了ATF6alpha在骨肉瘤侵袭性中的作用。最后，应用CellChat算法研究细胞间通讯。结果：利用高质量的人类骨肉瘤细胞图谱，我们确定了肿瘤纯度作为预后指标，并开发了稳健的肿瘤纯度预测模型。我们分别在单细胞分辨率下描绘了与骨肉瘤预后相关的癌细胞和免疫细胞内在分子特征。有趣的是，激活未折叠蛋白反应（unfolded protein response, UPR）通路的肿瘤细胞与疾病侵袭性显著相关。值得注意的是，ATF6alpha是该肿瘤亚簇中激活程度最高的转录因子。随后，我们确认ATF6alpha与骨肉瘤进展显著相关，而ATF6alpha的遗传和药理学抑制均损害了HOS细胞的存活。最后，我们描绘了肿瘤微环境中UPR相关亚簇与其他细胞类型之间的信号串扰景观。结论：总之，我们的工作为骨肉瘤的分子生物学提供了新见解，并为骨肉瘤生物标志物发现和治疗策略开发提供了宝贵资源。
